brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two deep bins bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full-x2 and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-full-x2 in two-storey full bases (fused 0,0 and 1,0), staged with spoon/fork/knife props standing in them, visible from above.

finish.summary: Built a two-bin utensil holder: two 2-storey full bases side by side, each with a deep solid (non-drained) full bin (hex-bin-full-x2), open faces capped and joints locked, staged with spoon, fork and knife props. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe could not be met/certified: the configurator checks fit only and material properties (water/heat resistance) depend on the user's chosen print material, so those two requirements are honestly unmet, though the solid-bin shape is suited to holding utensils.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
